text.tspan: 01 · Governed AI Exchange — private Azure platform topology

Conclusion: every data plane in this system — Cosmos, AI Search, Key Vault, the registry and Microsoft Foundry — is reachable only from inside the VNet, and the sole public surface is the demo UI front door.
Nothing below this line reaches an Azure data plane directly.
Entra ID interactive sign-in via MSAL.

apps/entra.tf — one app registration, three app roles:
Deliberately a public endpoint: it is an identity plane, not a data plane.
and apps/ (workloads). Control-plane access is not
what Principle II constrains — data planes are.
VNET fcmr-*-vnet 10.42.0.0/16 — NO PUBLIC DATA-PLANE ENDPOINT
Principle II, enforced by scripts/policy-no-public-endpoints.sh in CI: every resource below declares public access disabled. This boundary is the compliance claim the demo rests on.
Container Apps Environment · internal load balancer
One private endpoint per data plane. infrastructure/private-endpoints.tf.
AZURE DATA PLANES — publicNetworkAccess = false on every one
Entra-only authentication; local auth and account keys disabled (Principle VIII).
publicNetworkAccess Disabled · disableLocalAuth true · allowProjectManagement true. Not an AI Hub workspace.
Neither workspace has a private endpoint in infrastructure/*.tf — telemetry ingestion is the one data path that is not private-linked.
apps/container-apps.tf — the only container app with
external_enabled = true. This is the single public surface
The only workload identity holding "Azure AI Developer" on the
Foundry project (apps/roles.tf). Every model call in the system
passes through POST /v1/route. Internal ingress only.

Premium SKU is required for private link.
Hosted agents run under this project identity.
The only destination cleared for Restricted data.
60m timeouts — provision ahead of the demo.
APIM as AI gateway — NOT IN TERRAFORM
docs/architecture.md and the constitution both require all model
traffic to transit APIM for token metering, cost ceilings and content
safety. No azurerm_api_management resource exists in either stack,
and no private DNS zone for it is declared. Today the router calls the
Foundry data plane directly over the foundry private endpoint.
sampling_percentage = 100 — sampling is off so the
scoreboard is complete inside the 5s budget (AC-5, ADR 004).
Cosmos remains the system of record for audit.
Entra token issuance · managed identity · app roles
five private endpoints, six private DNS zones linked to the VNet —
each terminates on the data plane below
Inside the VNet / private endpoint only. No public data-plane endpoint.
Public or refusal / denial. The single public surface, or a governed "no".
Preview Azure capability (azapi, preview API version).
Governed chokepoint / deterministic code the exchange depends on.
Described in docs but ABSENT from infrastructure/*.tf and apps/*.tf.
What Beat 2 demonstrates with this picture
task cloud:prove-private attempts the same data-plane operation from outside and from inside the VNet: the first fails, the second
The CI policy job then shows that it cannot silently stop being private. The claim is continuous, not a point-in-time configuration.
Deliberately excluded (say so out loud): no high availability, no disaster recovery, no multi-region, no real execution, no real data.
